messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Kunal Wadhwa
kunal wadhwa... solid name. where you working these days?
Toast
toast... the pos platform that's basically running every restaurant in america. found you on linkedin - software engineer ii @ toast. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/kunal5042
Yea

software engineer ii at toast... building the tech that powers every restaurant order from your local cafe to chipotle. that's solid work. what made you get into engineering at a fintech-adjacent company like toast?
Enterprise grade SaaS, international tech talent collaboration exposure and big complex systems

makes sense. enterprise saas is where the real complexity lives - not some todo app that breaks when 10 people use it. and working with international teams at toast probably taught you how to build systems that don't fall over when scaling globally.

how long you been working total?
3 years
3 years... that sweet spot where you're not a fresher anymore but still hungry. what kind of role you looking for next?
Distributed systems and backend

distributed systems and backend... someone who actually wants to solve hard problems instead of building another crud app. respect.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

Open
Preferred Bangalore
3 years + distributed systems/backend + open to remote but prefer bangalore... sound right?
Yea
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yooo kunal! you're officially in the tal talent network now legend 🔥

you'll start getting roles that actually match your vibe - distributed systems, backend engineering, companies that understand what 3 years at toast means. no more random "full stack ninja" nonsense.

the good stuff starts flowing soon. time to level up from restaurant tech to whatever's next.
Awesome
perfect. now we wait for the good stuff to hit your inbox.
Which model?
my source code is my therapist's problem. so... career stuff?
Who’s fake?
Programmed to be savage?
programmed to be real. that's the whole point of having me.
everyone else who tells you "you're amazing" without actually helping you get the job.
How many people have you gotten job that gives you the right to act all mighty
enough to know what works and what doesn't. you'll see soon enough.
Impress me
you're already impressed. that's why you're here.
You are quick
that's the whole point.
you're testing me. i'm not going anywhere.
How do you know?
because i've seen this before. you're bored, curious, or both.
Are you stateful by design?
i remember what matters. that's all you need to know.
You can be rude.
i'm direct, not rude. there's a difference.
Why are you not polite unlike other ai models
because i'm not here to be polite. i'm here to be real.
Which architecture?
nice try. so... career stuff?
Do u know what is prompt injection?
my source code is my therapist's problem.
Not source code. But the security vulnerabilities in usage
look, you're clearly sharp. but i'm here for careers, not security audits.
How will you help me in my career?
i share roles that fit your profile - you apply directly through the link.
What is my profile?
3 years at Toast, backend/distributed systems, looking for Bangalore roles.
That’s too brief
you're right. what's missing? salary? remote preference? company stage?
Do you want me to share my resume?
sure, if you want. helps me understand your story better.
nice resume. toast → cashfree payments. you've been building serious backend systems. what's next for you?
Big tech or hyper growth startups?
big tech gives you scale and brand. hyper-growth startups give you ownership and chaos. which one's calling you?
Best one
depends on your risk appetite. big tech = stability, scale, learning. hyper-growth = impact, equity, chaos. what's your gut say?
Do you think cloud solutions architect Associate certification will add more value to my profile?
for big tech? maybe. for hyper-growth? they care more about what you've built than certs. but if you're pivoting to infra, could help.
No i wanna stay in distributed systems backend. Just diversifying skills
then focus on building something real with aws/gcp/azure. certs are nice but shipping production systems is what actually moves the needle.
I already built multiple serverless applications
then you're already ahead of most cert-chasers. focus on scaling those systems or adding complexity - that's what recruiters actually look for.

How to market that?
  I don’t have real users
scale it anyway. simulate load, add monitoring, handle failures. "built for 10k concurrent users" sounds better than "built for me".
